peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 12.9% below its local comparables; 13 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (79.6): 5.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 86 of 108 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 83.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $954,000 ($1,287 psf, 645–1,022 sq ft; 14 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,478 psf (range $1,211–1,702); 12.9% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $142,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tampines East MRT about 1,010 m, Upper Changi MRT about 1,500 m; closer than 25 of 116 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest East Spring Primary School about 430 m; more than 14 of 116 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 220 m), more than 7 of 116 similar developments (the same as 19); nearest hawker centre Tampines Round Market And Food Centre about 2,480 m; nearest park Tampines Eco Green Park about 1,750 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Tampines Round Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Kassia, 22 new sales, about 240 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 33 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 22 new sales and 410 resales (432 purchases); new sales were 5.1% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 410 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 54 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 410 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 508 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−19.3%). Planning-area private resales −4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
